findings.description: Large section of ceiling and roof material is missing in the upper center area, with exposed structural framing and sky visible through the opening.
Structural roof framing members are clearly exposed and visible through the large opening in the ceiling where roofing material has been destroyed or removed.
Extensive debris covering the floor including broken building materials, wood pieces, and destroyed structural components scattered throughout the room.
Walls show severe deterioration with large areas of damaged and discolored surfaces, particularly visible on the walls surrounding the openings.
